title: 30th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/30/2024).
First reading of the bill amending Law No. 12/2016 (Criminal Procedure Act), submitted by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Preliminary debate on the Urban Development Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Vilingili MP Azim Abdul Azeez.
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the Maldives Environmental Management Project for 2014 and 2015.
Judiciary Committee report on a matter submitted regarding the Tax Appeal Tribunal.
Committee of the Whole House report on the bill amending Law No. 2/99 (Maldives Tourism Act).
Security Services Committee report on the bill amending Law No. 2/2008 (Employment Act).
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the Prosecutor General's Office for 2013 to 2021.
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the Maldives Civil Aviation Authority for 2014 to 2023.
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives for 2018 to 2022.
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the National Integrity Commission for 2019 to 2022.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to introduce a Criminal Procedure Act amendment, open debate on the Urban Development Bill, and take up eight committee reports, mostly on old audit reports.
